transcript.title: Weekly round-up
transcript.text: Hello, I'm Nova, the Ventryx AI presenter. This is your weekly market round-up for the week ending Friday 9 October.

transcript.title: Markets this week
transcript.text: Here's how the markets closed the week. The S&P 500 finished up 1.2 per cent. The tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 was up 0.2 per cent, and here in London the FTSE 100 ended up 0.9 per cent. Bitcoin was down 2.2 per cent over seven days.

transcript.title: Biggest movers
transcript.text: Among the hundred big US stocks we track, the top riser was Shopify, up 12.9 per cent, followed by Palantir and Intuit. At the other end, Arm Holdings fell 13.4 per cent, with Intel and Deere also lower.

transcript.title: In the headlines
transcript.text: In the news on Shopify, Yahoo Finance ran the headline: 1 Stat That Makes Shopify Hard to Ignore Right Now.

transcript.title: In the headlines
transcript.text: In the news on Arm Holdings, Yahoo Finance ran the headline: Qualcomm Waits on a Jury: Arm Has a $443 Million Customer on the Line.

transcript.title: Momentum top 5
transcript.text: On the Ventryx momentum list, this month's five are Micron Technology, Dell, Advanced Micro Devices, Intel and Marvell Technology. All five are holding their places for now. The next swap is on Friday 30 October.

transcript.title: Crypto top 5
transcript.text: In crypto, our experimental top five are Zcash, Uniswap, NEAR Protocol, Arbitrum and Chainlink, with Bitcoin 15 per cent above its two-hundred-day average.

transcript.title: Next week
transcript.text: Looking ahead to the week of Monday 12 October. Results are due from JPMorgan Chase, Johnson & Johnson and UnitedHealth on Tuesday; ASML Holding, Bank of America and Morgan Stanley on Wednesday. And on the prediction market Polymarket, the question "Will Bitcoin reach $87,500 in October?" is trading at about 48 per cent yes.

transcript.title: That's the week
transcript.text: That's your round-up. Remember, this is research, not financial advice. I'm Nova. See you next Sunday.
